name: rlarch
description: Three skills for .NET work and large multi-step jobs. dotnet-reflect: inspect any NuGet package or assembly's API surface — exact signatures, XML-doc summaries, decompiled method bodies, reverse find-usages from IL, and version diffs, read straight from the DLL on disk. dotnet-source: ReSharper-style navigation of the .NET solution you're editing — search by name and kind, outline a type including private members with partials merged, god-class metrics, and semantic find-usages / impls / calls / unused, read from .cs with Roslyn so it works on code that doesn't compile. orchestrate: execute a large plan or spec by delegating every task to subagents, verifying each result against the goal, and re-planning when reality diverges, keeping the main context clean.
